issues.problem: From about +15.0 to the 'cheered' fade (about +26.1), the Nobel citation ribbon stays at 55% alpha over the audience. Heads, shoulders and candelabra show through the paper and its lettering (full frame at +20.29), so for about 10 s the frame reads as a double exposure. This is the same class of problem that round 4 fixed in ch14-s02. The ribbon also sits under the medallion push, so it is the second-brightest thing in frame during the Boltzmann beat.
issues.fix: Make the ribbon opaque. When the medallion push starts ('memories' - 0.2), slide it out of frame lower-left with the camera instead of dimming it, or fade it fully to 0 over 0.4 s at that point. Do not hold an intermediate alpha. Verify stills at +16.4, +20.3 and +25.7: either a solid ribbon or none.

issues.problem: The 1 s crossfade in from ch04-s06 (0.0 to about 0.7) double-exposes the outgoing frame's whole text load over the winter valley: the Papert 1988 quote, the TRANSLATION 1966, MANSFIELD 1969, PERCEPTRONS 1969 and LIGHTHILL 1973 cards, the A-B-C card and a figure ghost, all at 40-50% (full frame at +0.17). It reads as a muddy multi-card smear. The ghost-text audit is per shot, so it cannot see this. In the other crossfades I sampled (ch05-s03, ch08-s09, ch11-s03, ch12-s02) the frames are clean.
issues.fix: Either fade ch04-s06's cards and quote out over its last 0.6 s, so the crossfade blends picture into picture, or change ch04-s07's transitionIn to 'cut' (the house windows lighting can carry the change). Verify stills at ch04-s07 +0.1, +0.3 and +0.5 with no readable outgoing text.

issues.problem: The round-4 ghost-text QA records text layers inside one shot. It does not composite the outgoing shot's last frames under the incoming shot's crossfade, paperWipe or inkBleed. The film has 42 one-second crossfades, so cross-shot text ghosts such as ch04-s07 +0.17 pass QA unseen.
issues.fix: In cards.mjs, for each transitionIn other than cut, render the transition window with both shots' recorded text boxes, each scaled by its transition weight, and apply the same 25%/0.25 s overlap rule. Add the result to sheets.ghostText and list any offenders per incoming shot.

issues.problem: Around 'liang' (+7.2 to +8.3) the move from the close gap-candle framing to the wide is a dissolve between two framings, not a camera move. At +7.50 the 2022 candles are about 50% transparent with the skyline and the light behind them showing through. The three tags are still at about 80%, cropped at the left edge. The Liang quote is at 30%. Three layers sit half-visible at once for about 1 s.
issues.fix: Replace the dissolve with one continuous pull-back (ease.move, 1.0 s) on a single shelf plane, so the candles stay opaque the whole time. Finish the textSwapOut on the tags before 7.2 so they are at 0 before the quote passes 30%. Verify stills at 7.3, 7.5 and 7.8.

issues.problem: Three things. (a) In the opening wide (0.4 to about 3.0), every lab is named twice: a brass plate on the plinth (GOOGLE DEEPMIND, ANTHROPIC, OPENAI, META) and a hanging tag underneath ('ANTHROPIC / as of October 2026', and so on). That is eight labels for four objects. (b) The defocused finial is still a soft, dark, round-headed blob at the bottom edge (x about 89%, y about 90%) from 0 to 1 s, and it reads as a head. (c) Under the OpenAI 'warning shot' quote (+35.8 to +38.0), the soft dark plate shows as a rectangular smudge on the bookcase.
issues.fix: (a) Leave the brass plates blank (an engraved rule only) and let the routed hanging tags carry the names, or drop the tags' name line and keep only 'as of October 2026'. (b) Give the finial a turned, rim-lit profile (a knob plus a collar, 2 px warm rim), or move it fully below frame. (c) Feather the quote plate to 40 px or more, or drop it: the quote already clears 4.5:1 against the dark bookcase. Verify stills at 0.4, 0.9 and 36.5.

issues.problem: The film's last action is the hand striking the match (+19.8 to +22.1). The hand is the crudest puppet piece in the film: a faceted, blocky mitten with no separate thumb, and three stacked rectangular cuff slabs (full frame at +21.35). Other shots (ch12-s03, ch05-s06) use the kit's articulated paper-cut hand, and the reference's hands are fine-cut with lace cuffs.
issues.fix: Swap in the kit's articulated hand with a thumb-and-forefinger pinch on the matchstick, one cuff with a 2 px warm rim and a single button. Keep the timing (in on 'suspicious', strike on 'new', flare on 'candles'). Verify stills at 20.5, 21.4 and 21.9.

issues.problem: On 'argued', ', still argued' types onto the LEARNED FEATURES card at 30 characters per second (', s' at +20.08). The cut back to the Wall comes about 0.3 s after the last character, so the addition reads as a flicker, not a statement.
issues.fix: Start the type-on 0.3 s earlier, or type at 45 characters per second, and hold the finished card at least 0.8 s before the cut. Or drop the suffix: the burning candle already says the belief is still alive. Verify a still at the cut minus 0.1 s showing the complete line.

issues.problem: On 'letter' (+7.83) the pause letter falls into frame as a blank pale rectangle. Its ruled lines appear only at about +8.9, so for about 1 s it is a placeholder card. The cards audit lists it as unprobed paper.
issues.fix: Print the letter (header line, ruled text and a signature scrawl at about 60% ink) from its first visible frame, and add cardProbe. Verify a still at 7.9.

best_moments: ch15-s06 (fixed after three rounds): a quiet wall of forecast slips, then the hall with its new checker floor and balustrade. Hinton's warning hand rises on 'warn' while the LeCun 'off-ramp' quote inks over the third holdout. The silhouette staging is the closest in the film to the reference's two-figure tableau.

ch15-s09: the CASE FILE stamped STATUS: OPEN under the verdict slip, then black with a single cyan cursor, then the lit window across the street. The match flares on 'candles', and the new taper burns beside the 2025 stub as the room goes dark.

ch15-s01: a cut from Hinton's 2 a.m. bedroom into the Hall of Mirrors, with the JOHN HOPFIELD card at the podium. The medallion push lets a ball roll into the energy dip while Boltzmann dots settle on 'cools', which teaches the mechanism through the prize itself.
ch08-s06 (fixed): the rose window moves only through states of its own tile grid, from television snow to strokes on each 'nudge' to the learned mosaic, under the stencil cathedral.

ch13-s04: three camps on one stage, now with real gestures (Gebru's hand at her chin, LeCun mid-argument by the server rack), the checker floor and the three 2018 Turing medals descending on 'medals'.
ch10-s12 (fixed): the matrix flows into the GPU racks, one quiet TIME card, then the word-bridge grows from 10 to 20 words and the all-pairs net blooms into 'cost ∝ n²'. One fact, one image.
ch14-s07: the winter harbour, the ringed gap taper, the Liang quote over the fog, and STATUS: OPEN struck on 'stands' with its own clack.
